about: Conformance vectors for extractor 1's mail documents (DESIGN-DETAILS section 11.2; protocol/INDEX-FORMAT.md's Extractor 1). input is the message, the concatenation of its parts: t is UTF-8 text, x is hex (used for anything that is not UTF-8 or holds an invisible code point), n a repeat count. Each document gives fields 1 (subject), 2 (from), 3 (to) and 5 (body) before normalization, an absent one being empty; text, the document's normalized text under normalizer 1; keys, its count of distinct trigrams; and row, its row's display values and size. A value too long to print is its len and sha256. rule names the rules of 11.2 the vector pins.
